capabilities: Sync X bookmarks into the vault as one Markdown note per tweet
Log in via an embedded X window to capture the session cookie
Render bookmark notes through a customizable Nunjucks template
Download tweet images, videos and GIFs into local attachments
Generate monthly AI digests of new bookmarks via local Ollama
disambiguation: Unrelated to Obsidian's built-in Bookmarks feature; it syncs Twitter/X bookmarks into notes.
extras: Unofficial plugin not reviewed by Obsidian staff; uses X's private web API with your own cookie for personal use only, which X may break at any time. Cookie is stored locally and sent only to x.com. Embedded login is desktop-only (Electron); mobile users must paste a cookie string. Install is via BRAT or manual file copy.
motivation: The README says the dedup design addresses a pain point with obsidian-weread-plugin: notes are never overwritten so manual annotations survive re-syncs.
problem: X bookmarks live inside X's app with no export, so saved tweets can't be searched, archived permanently, or used by other tools.

relations.evidence: Architecture mirrors obsidian-weread-plugin: embedded web login captures your session cookie
Optional AI monthly digest via your local Ollama
that cookie calls X's internal GraphQL Bookmarks endpoint

requires.name: Ollama (local, for the optional AI digest)

summary: Syncs your Twitter/X bookmarks into the vault as Markdown notes via X's private GraphQL API, with optional local-Ollama monthly digests.
